fullDescription: A clean shadcn-style SaaS data table ('Tablecraft') on a white surface with one emerald accent and Inter: a sortable tasks table with a tri-state select-all, faceted-filter toolbar, semantic status/priority state icons, a selected-row treatment, an open row-actions menu, and an honest pagination footer.
prompt:
## Resumo
A clean, light SaaS data-table showcase ('Tablecraft') built around THE engineered data table, a shadcn-style tasks table that feels designed-in, not bolted on. The page is a near-white surface (#ffffff) on a faint ink-tinted canvas (#f8fafc) carried by a single Inter typeface and one emerald accent (#10b981 / #059669) over a cool slate 'ink' neutral scale (#0f172a down to #f8fafc). A sticky translucent nav (an emerald rounded table-2 logo tile + 'Tablecraft' wordmark, four nav links, a sign-in link and a dark 'Get the kit' pill), a centered hero on a subtly grid-lined band ('Data tables that feel engineered, not bolted on.' with 'engineered' in emerald, a sparkles 'Generated from one prompt' pill, and two CTAs), then THE component: a rounded, soft-shadowed table card on a neutral canvas. The card stacks a filter toolbar (a search input, two dashed faceted-filter buttons, a View button and an emerald 'New task' button), a real sortable tasks table (tri-state select-all checkbox column, sortable headers with chevron carets and an active emerald sort caret, type-badge + truncated title cells, status cells with lucide state icons, priority cells with arrow icons, and a row-actions ellipsis column with one open dropdown menu), and an honest pagination footer (a selected-row count, a rows-per-page control, a page-of-N readout, and first/prev/next/last edge buttons that disable at the bounds). Below the card, a three-up bordered feature strip (Sortable / Bulk selection / Honest pagination). A light footer closes it. Crisp, product-grade, tabular, calm; reflows from a full desktop table to a horizontally scrollable min-width table on mobile.

## Estilo Visual
Design a clean, product-grade SaaS data-table UI in the shadcn / Vercel idiom. Surface is pure white #ffffff sitting on a faint ink-tinted page canvas #f8fafc. Use a single typeface, Inter (weights 400, 500, 600, 700, 800), with font-feature-settings 'cv11','ss01' and a .tnum utility (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for IDs and counts. Palette: one emerald accent, emerald-500 #10b981 (primary fills, active sort, selected row), emerald-600 #059669 (hover), emerald-700 #047857 (accent text), emerald-50 #ecfdf5 and emerald-100 #d1fae5 (tints/badges), emerald-200 #a7f3d0 and emerald-300 #6ee7b7 (borders/glow), over a cool slate 'ink' neutral scale: ink-900 #0f172a, ink-800 #1e293b, ink-700 #334155, ink-600 #475569, ink-500 #64748b, ink-400 #94a3b8, ink-300 #cbd5e1, ink-200 #e2e8f0, ink-100 #f1f5f9, ink-50 #f8fafc. Text is ink-900 primary, ink-500/ink-600 secondary, ink-400 muted. Build structure from hairline ink-200 borders, rounding (rounded-lg 8px buttons/inputs, rounded-xl 12px menus, rounded-2xl 16px cards) and soft layered shadows, not heavy lines: the main table card uses a two-layer shadow shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(15,23,42,0.04),0_12px_40px_-12px_rgba(15,23,42,0.12)]. Keep UI text small (13-14px) at medium/semibold weight, headings tight-tracked, the hero in extrabold (text-5xl/6xl, leading-[1.05]). Use color sparingly and semantically: emerald for the active sort caret, the selected row (a 3px inset emerald-500 left rule + emerald-50/50 row tint), primary buttons and the 'In Progress' status; rose-600 only for the destructive Delete menu item. Interactions are quiet and CSS-driven: table rows transition background-color .14s on hover (ink-50/70 tint, emerald-50/80 on the selected row), the dark and emerald buttons darken on hover, dashed faceted-filter buttons turn their border and text emerald on hover, pagination edge buttons turn emerald on hover and render disabled (ink-300, no hover) at the bounds, and a custom 16px rounded checkbox animates between unchecked, checked (emerald fill + white tick) and indeterminate (emerald fill + white dash). The hero band carries a faint emerald grid texture (two 1px linear-gradients in rgba(16,185,129,0.05) on a 56px tile) plus a soft emerald-300/20 blur glow. Antialiased, optimizeLegibility. Sober, engineered, calm, trustworthy; never noisy or decorative.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) on a translucent white bg (bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-md) with a hairline ink-200/70 bottom border, 64px tall (h-16), inside a max-w-7xl px-6/lg:px-8 row, items-center justify-between. Left group (gap-9): brand = a 32px rounded-lg emerald-500 tile (h-8 w-8, shadow-sm shadow-emerald-500/30) centering a white lucide:table-2 icon, then a 17px font-extrabold tracking-tight 'Tablecraft' wordmark; then (md+ only) a nav of four 14px font-medium ink-600 links (Components, Tables [active, ink-900], Templates, Docs) that go ink-900 on hover. Right group (gap-3): a 14px ink-600 'Sign in' link (sm+ only) and a primary pill 'Get the kit' = rounded-lg bg-ink-900 px-4 py-2 14px font-semibold white with a trailing lucide:arrow-right, hover:bg-ink-800.

### Hero
A relative overflow-hidden section with a hairline ink-200/70 bottom border on a faint ink-50/40 band carrying a .grid-faded emerald grid texture, plus a pointer-events-none soft emerald-300/20 blur-3xl glow near the top center. Inside a max-w-7xl px-6/lg:px-8 column, centered, py-16/lg:py-20. Top: a pill badge = rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3.5 py-1.5 12px font-semibold emerald-700 with a lucide:sparkles icon, reading 'Generated from one prompt'. Then a max-w-3xl text-balance extrabold headline, leading-[1.05], tracking-tight, text-5xl/lg:text-6xl: 'Data tables that feel ' then 'engineered' in emerald-600 then ', not bolted on.' Below: a max-w-xl 18px leading-relaxed ink-500 sub-paragraph ('Sortable headers, faceted filters, row selection, and a pagination footer that actually adds up. Copy the markup, ship the screen.'). Then a centered actions row (gap-3, flex-wrap): a primary emerald button 'Prompt this table' (rounded-xl bg-emerald-500 px-5 py-3 14px font-semibold white, shadow-md shadow-emerald-500/25, a leading lucide:wand-2, hover:bg-emerald-600) and a secondary 'View source' button (rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-white px-5 py-3 14px font-semibold ink-700, a leading lucide:code-xml, hover:border-ink-300 hover:bg-ink-50).

### Showcase caption row
Inside the white main (id=showcase, max-w-7xl, py-16/lg:py-20), a caption row above the table card (mb-7, flex-col -> sm:flex-row, sm:items-end sm:justify-between): left a 24px font-bold tracking-tight ink-900 'Tasks' heading over a 14px ink-500 'Here's a list of your tasks for this sprint.' subline; right a small 12px font-medium ink-400 status line with an emerald-500 lucide:circle-check-big icon reading 'Live preview · fully interactive markup'.

### The data table card (the hero component)
A rounded-2xl table card: overflow-hidden, border border-ink-200, bg-white, with the two-layer soft shadow shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(15,23,42,0.04),0_12px_40px_-12px_rgba(15,23,42,0.12)]. It stacks three regions vertically: (1) a filter TOOLBAR with a hairline ink-200/80 bottom border; (2) the sortable TABLE inside an overflow-x-auto wrapper; (3) the pagination FOOTER with a hairline ink-200/80 top border. See the dedicated component prompts for the toolbar, table and footer.

### Table toolbar
A toolbar inside the card (p-4, flex-col -> lg:flex-row, lg:items-center lg:justify-between, gap-3) with a hairline ink-200/80 bottom border. Left filter group (flex-1, flex-wrap, gap-2.5): a search input (relative, sm:max-w-xs) = h-9 rounded-lg border border-ink-200 bg-white with a leading lucide:search ink-400 icon (absolute left-3) and placeholder 'Filter tasks…', focus:border-emerald-400 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20; then two dashed faceted-filter buttons = h-9 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-ink-300 bg-white px-3 14px font-medium ink-600, hover:border-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-700, the first (lucide:circle-dashed) 'Status' carrying an inline selected-value group (an emerald-50/emerald-700 'In Progress' chip + an ink-100/ink-600 '+1' chip behind a left ink-200 divider, sm+ only), the second (lucide:bar-chart-3) 'Priority'. Right actions group (gap-2): a 'View' button (h-9 rounded-lg border border-ink-200 bg-white px-3 14px font-medium ink-700, lucide:sliders-horizontal, hover:bg-ink-50) and a primary emerald 'New task' button (h-9 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500 px-3.5 14px font-semibold white, lucide:plus, hover:bg-emerald-600).

### Sortable tasks table
A real table (w-full min-w-[760px] border-collapse text-sm) inside an overflow-x-auto wrapper. THEAD: one row, border-b border-ink-200/80 on a bg-ink-50/60, text-left. Columns: (1) a w-12 select-all cell holding a tri-state custom checkbox in the indeterminate state; (2) 'Task', (3) 'Title', (4) 'Status' (active sort), (5) 'Priority' headers, each a button group of the label + a sort caret, inactive headers use a muted ink-400 lucide:chevrons-up-down that goes ink-600 on group hover and the label goes ink-900, the ACTIVE 'Status' header is emerald-700 with an emerald-600 lucide:arrow-down caret; (6) a trailing w-12 empty actions header. TBODY (divide-y divide-ink-100): six rows (.row-hover, transition background-color .14s). Each row has a checkbox cell, a tnum ink-500 font-medium task-id cell (TASK-8782 etc.), a Title cell (a small type badge + a max-w-[320px] truncate ink-800 font-medium title), a Status cell (a lucide state icon + label), a Priority cell (a lucide arrow icon + label), and a right-aligned actions cell (a 28px rounded-md ellipsis button, hover:bg-ink-100). Type badges: 'Documentation'/'Bug' = a neutral chip (border border-ink-200 bg-white 11px font-semibold ink-500), 'Feature' = an emerald chip (border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 emerald-700). Status values + icons: 'In Progress' = emerald-500 lucide:loader-circle, 'Backlog' = ink-400 lucide:circle-dashed, 'Done' = emerald-600 lucide:circle-check-big, 'Canceled' = ink-400 lucide:circle-x (label ink-500). Priority values + icons: 'High' = lucide:arrow-up, 'Medium' = lucide:minus, 'Low' = lucide:arrow-down (all ink-400 icons, ink-700 labels). ROW 1 is the SELECTED state: bg-emerald-50/50 (hover emerald-50/80), its checkbox is checked, and its first cell carries a 3px inset emerald-500 left rule (shadow-[inset_3px_0_0_0_#10b981]). ROW 3 shows the row-actions dropdown OPEN: its ellipsis button is pressed (bg-ink-100) and an absolute menu sits below it.

### Row-actions dropdown menu (open state)
On row 3, an absolute dropdown (right-0 top-9 z-20, w-44) = rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-white py-1 with a strong soft shadow shadow-xl shadow-ink-900/10. Items are full-width left-aligned 13px font-medium ink-700 rows (px-3 py-2, gap-2.5, an ink-400 lucide leading icon, hover:bg-ink-50): 'Edit' (lucide:pen-line), 'Make a copy' (lucide:copy), 'Favorite' (lucide:star); then a 1px ink-100 divider; then a destructive 'Delete' row in rose-600 (lucide:trash-2, hover:bg-rose-50) with a trailing ink-300 '⌘⌫' keyboard hint.

### Pagination footer
A footer inside the card (px-4 py-3.5, 14px ink-500, flex-col -> sm:flex-row, sm:items-center sm:justify-between, gap-4) with a hairline ink-200/80 top border. Left: a .tnum selected-row count '1 of 6 row(s) selected.'. Right group (flex-wrap, gap-x-6 gap-y-3): a 'Rows per page' label (font-medium ink-600) + a small h-8 rounded-lg border ink-200 bg-white button '10' with a lucide:chevrons-up-down; a tnum 'Page 1 of 8' readout; and an edge-controls group (gap-1.5) of four 32px square rounded-lg border ink-200 bg-white icon buttons, lucide:chevrons-left and lucide:chevron-left DISABLED (ink-300, no hover), lucide:chevron-right and lucide:chevrons-right enabled (ink-700, hover:border-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-50 hover:text-emerald-700).

### Feature strip
Below the table (mt-12), a three-up bordered strip = grid gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 on a bg-ink-200 ground (so the 1px gaps read as hairlines), sm:grid-cols-3. Each cell is a bg-white p-6 panel with a 36px rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 emerald-600 lucide icon tile, a 14px font-bold ink-900 title and a 14px leading-relaxed ink-500 line: 'Sortable, every column' (lucide:arrow-up-down) / 'Bulk selection' (lucide:check-check) / 'Honest pagination' (lucide:list-ordered).

### Footer
A full-bleed footer with a hairline ink-200/70 top border on a faint ink-50/40 band, a max-w-7xl px-6/lg:px-8 row, py-8, flex-col -> sm:flex-row, items-center justify-between, gap-4, 14px ink-500. Left: a 24px rounded-md emerald-500 tile with a white lucide:table-2 + a font-semibold ink-700 'Tablecraft' wordmark. Center: 'Built from a single prompt · designed in the open'. Right: three ink-400 social icon links (lucide:github, lucide:twitter, lucide:book-open) that go emerald-600 on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Tri-state custom checkbox (.checkbox)
A 16px custom checkbox replacing the native control: appearance none, width/height 16px, border-radius 5px, 1.5px solid #cbd5e1 (ink-300) border, white background, inline-grid place-content-center, transition all .12s. On :hover the border goes #10b981 (emerald). The :checked state fills #10b981 with an emerald border and renders a white tick via an ::after element masked from an inline SVG checkmark (9px). An '.indet' (indeterminate) state fills emerald and renders a 9px x 2px white horizontal dash instead of the tick, used on the select-all header to mean 'some but not all rows selected'.

### Sortable column header
A clickable table header rendered as a button group: the column label + a sort caret icon, transition-colors. INACTIVE columns are ink-500 with a muted ink-400 lucide:chevrons-up-down (up-down double caret) that brightens to ink-600 and whose label goes ink-900 on group hover. The ACTIVE-sort column is emerald-700 with a directional emerald-600 caret (lucide:arrow-down for descending / lucide:arrow-up for ascending), so the active sort is the only colored header in the row, the one place emerald marks state in the header.

### Selected row treatment
The selected table row gets a soft emerald wash (bg-emerald-50/50, hover bg-emerald-50/80), its row checkbox is :checked (emerald fill + white tick), and its first cell carries a 3px inset emerald accent rule on the left edge via box-shadow inset 3px 0 0 0 #10b981, a precise 'this row is selected' affordance that doesn't add layout width.

### Dashed faceted-filter button
A filter trigger styled as a dashed-outline button: h-9 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-ink-300 bg-white px-3, 14px font-medium ink-600, with a leading lucide icon (circle-dashed for Status, bar-chart-3 for Priority) and the filter name; on hover the dashed border and text turn emerald (hover:border-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-700). When values are selected it appends, behind a left ink-200 divider (border-l pl-2), small value chips: an emerald-50/emerald-700 '11px font-semibold' value chip ('In Progress') and an ink-100/ink-600 overflow chip ('+1'); the chip group hides below sm.

### Status / priority cell with state icon
Each status and priority cell is an inline-flex of a small (13-14px) lucide state icon + a text label. Status uses semantic icons/colors: In Progress = emerald-500 loader-circle, Done = emerald-600 circle-check-big, Backlog = ink-400 circle-dashed, Canceled = ink-400 circle-x (with a muted ink-500 label). Priority uses neutral ink-400 directional icons: High = arrow-up, Medium = minus, Low = arrow-down, all with ink-700 labels. The icon carries the meaning and color; the label stays neutral, so scanning the column reads as a column of glyphs first.

### Soft-shadow table card
The container for the whole table = rounded-2xl, overflow-hidden, 1px ink-200 border, white background, and a two-layer shadow shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(15,23,42,0.04),0_12px_40px_-12px_rgba(15,23,42,0.12)]: a tight 1px ambient shadow for the edge plus a soft, far, slightly-negative-spread drop shadow that lifts the card off the canvas without a hard halo. It vertically stacks toolbar / table / footer, each separated by an internal ink-200/80 hairline border.

### Pagination edge controls
A group of four 32px square rounded-lg buttons (border ink-200, bg-white) for first / previous / next / last (lucide:chevrons-left, chevron-left, chevron-right, chevrons-right). At page 1 the first/previous buttons are DISABLED (ink-300 icon, the disabled attribute, no hover), and the enabled next/last buttons go emerald on hover (hover:border-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-50 hover:text-emerald-700), an 'honest' control that visibly disables at the bounds rather than looking clickable.

### Emerald grid hero band (.grid-faded)
The hero background texture: two 1px linear-gradients (to right and to bottom) in rgba(16,185,129,0.05) on a background-size 56px 56px tile, producing a barely-there emerald graph-paper grid, layered under a pointer-events-none soft emerald-300/20 blur-3xl radial glow near the top center, on a faint ink-50/40 band. It signals 'engineered / on a canvas' without competing with the table.

## Notas Especiais
Built on the Tailwind CDN with a tailwind.config extend: fontFamily.sans = Inter (ui-sans-serif fallback); a full custom emerald scale (50 #ecfdf5, 100 #d1fae5, 200 #a7f3d0, 300 #6ee7b7, 400 #34d399, 500 #10b981, 600 #059669, 700 #047857, 800 #065f46, 900 #064e3b) and a cool slate 'ink' scale (50 #f8fafc, 100 #f1f5f9, 200 #e2e8f0, 300 #cbd5e1, 400 #94a3b8, 500 #64748b, 600 #475569, 700 #334155, 800 #1e293b, 900 #0f172a). Inter loads from Google Fonts (400;500;600;700;800); icons are Iconify lucide:* via the iconify CDN. Body sets font-feature-settings 'cv11','ss01', antialiased, optimizeLegibility, and a .tnum (tabular-nums) utility aligns IDs and counts. The signature move is the engineered shadcn-style tasks data table inside a soft-shadow rounded-2xl card: a tri-state select-all + per-row custom checkbox (.checkbox / .indet), sortable headers where only the active-sort column is emerald, semantic status/priority state-icon cells, a selected-row treatment (emerald wash + 3px inset emerald left rule), dashed faceted-filter buttons with value chips, one open row-actions dropdown, and an honest pagination footer whose edge buttons disable at the bounds. It is a single static demo frame: row hover tints, the focus ring, the checkbox state animation, the dashed-filter and pagination hover color shifts, and the (single) open dropdown only fully animate/toggle live, and the task rows, IDs, statuses and 'Tablecraft' brand are illustrative placeholders for a generic tasks/admin data table.

Inside a max-w-7xl px-6/lg:px-8 column, centered, py-16/lg:py-20. Top: a pill badge = rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3.5 py-1.5 12px font-semibold emerald-700 with a lucide:sparkles icon, reading 'Generated from one prompt'. Then a max-w-3xl text-balance extrabold headline, leading-[1.05], tracking-tight, text-5xl/lg:text-6xl: 'Data tables that feel ' then 'engineered' in emerald-600 then ', not bolted on.' Below: a max-w-xl 18px leading-relaxed ink-500 sub-paragraph ('Sortable headers, faceted filters, row selection, and a pagination footer that actually adds up. Copy the markup, ship the screen.'). Then a centered actions row (gap-3, flex-wrap): a primary emerald button 'Prompt this table' (rounded-xl bg-emerald-500 px-5 py-3 14px font-semibold white, shadow-md shadow-emerald-500/25, a leading lucide:wand-2, hover:bg-emerald-600) and a secondary 'View source' button (rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-white px-5 py-3 14px font-semibold ink-700, a leading lucide:code-xml, hover:border-ink-300 hover:bg-ink-50).

Inside the white main (id=showcase, max-w-7xl, py-16/lg:py-20), a caption row above the table card (mb-7, flex-col -> sm:flex-row, sm:items-end sm:justify-between): left a 24px font-bold tracking-tight ink-900 'Tasks' heading over a 14px ink-500 'Here's a list of your tasks for this sprint.' subline; right a small 12px font-medium ink-400 status line with an emerald-500 lucide:circle-check-big icon reading 'Live preview · fully interactive markup'.

prompts.part: The data table card (the hero component)
prompts.partPt: The data table card (the Topo Principal (Hero) component)
prompts.prompt: A rounded-2xl table card: overflow-hidden, border border-ink-200, bg-white, with the two-layer soft shadow shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(15,23,42,0.04),0_12px_40px_-12px_rgba(15,23,42,0.12)]. It stacks three regions vertically: (1) a filter TOOLBAR with a hairline ink-200/80 bottom border; (2) the sortable TABLE inside an overflow-x-auto wrapper; (3) the pagination FOOTER with a hairline ink-200/80 top border. See the dedicated component prompts for the toolbar, table and footer.

A toolbar inside the card (p-4, flex-col -> lg:flex-row, lg:items-center lg:justify-between, gap-3) with a hairline ink-200/80 bottom border. Left filter group (flex-1, flex-wrap, gap-2.5): a search input (relative, sm:max-w-xs) = h-9 rounded-lg border border-ink-200 bg-white with a leading lucide:search ink-400 icon (absolute left-3) and placeholder 'Filter tasks…', focus:border-emerald-400 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20; then two dashed faceted-filter buttons = h-9 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-ink-300 bg-white px-3 14px font-medium ink-600, hover:border-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-700, the first (lucide:circle-dashed) 'Status' carrying an inline selected-value group (an emerald-50/emerald-700 'In Progress' chip + an ink-100/ink-600 '+1' chip behind a left ink-200 divider, sm+ only), the second (lucide:bar-chart-3) 'Priority'. Right actions group (gap-2): a 'View' button (h-9 rounded-lg border border-ink-200 bg-white px-3 14px font-medium ink-700, lucide:sliders-horizontal, hover:bg-ink-50) and a primary emerald 'New task' button (h-9 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500 px-3.5 14px font-semibold white, lucide:plus, hover:bg-emerald-600).

A real table (w-full min-w-[760px] border-collapse text-sm) inside an overflow-x-auto wrapper. THEAD: one row, border-b border-ink-200/80 on a bg-ink-50/60, text-left. Columns: (1) a w-12 select-all cell holding a tri-state custom checkbox in the indeterminate state; (2) 'Task', (3) 'Title', (4) 'Status' (active sort), (5) 'Priority' headers, each a button group of the label + a sort caret, inactive headers use a muted ink-400 lucide:chevrons-up-down that goes ink-600 on group hover and the label goes ink-900, the ACTIVE 'Status' header is emerald-700 with an emerald-600 lucide:arrow-down caret; (6) a trailing w-12 empty actions header. TBODY (divide-y divide-ink-100): six rows (.row-hover, transition background-color .14s). Each row has a checkbox cell, a tnum ink-500 font-medium task-id cell (TASK-8782 etc.), a Title cell (a small type badge + a max-w-[320px] truncate ink-800 font-medium title), a Status cell (a lucide state icon + label), a Priority cell (a lucide arrow icon + label), and a right-aligned actions cell (a 28px rounded-md ellipsis button, hover:bg-ink-100). Type badges: 'Documentation'/'Bug' = a neutral chip (border border-ink-200 bg-white 11px font-semibold ink-500), 'Feature' = an emerald chip (border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 emerald-700). Status values + icons: 'In Progress' = emerald-500 lucide:loader-circle, 'Backlog' = ink-400 lucide:circle-dashed, 'Done' = emerald-600 lucide:circle-check-big, 'Canceled' = ink-400 lucide:circle-x (label ink-500). Priority values + icons: 'High' = lucide:arrow-up, 'Medium' = lucide:minus, 'Low' = lucide:arrow-down (all ink-400 icons, ink-700 labels). ROW 1 is the SELECTED state: bg-emerald-50/50 (hover emerald-50/80), its checkbox is checked, and its first cell carries a 3px inset emerald-500 left rule (shadow-[inset_3px_0_0_0_#10b981]). ROW 3 shows the row-actions dropdown OPEN: its ellipsis button is pressed (bg-ink-100) and an absolute menu sits below it.

On row 3, an absolute dropdown (right-0 top-9 z-20, w-44) = rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-white py-1 with a strong soft shadow shadow-xl shadow-ink-900/10. Items are full-width left-aligned 13px font-medium ink-700 rows (px-3 py-2, gap-2.5, an ink-400 lucide leading icon, hover:bg-ink-50): 'Edit' (lucide:pen-line), 'Make a copy' (lucide:copy), 'Favorite' (lucide:star); then a 1px ink-100 divider; then a destructive 'Delete' row in rose-600 (lucide:trash-2, hover:bg-rose-50) with a trailing ink-300 '⌘⌫' keyboard hint.

A footer inside the card (px-4 py-3.5, 14px ink-500, flex-col -> sm:flex-row, sm:items-center sm:justify-between, gap-4) with a hairline ink-200/80 top border. Left: a .tnum selected-row count '1 of 6 row(s) selected.'. Right group (flex-wrap, gap-x-6 gap-y-3): a 'Rows per page' label (font-medium ink-600) + a small h-8 rounded-lg border ink-200 bg-white button '10' with a lucide:chevrons-up-down; a tnum 'Page 1 of 8' readout; and an edge-controls group (gap-1.5) of four 32px square rounded-lg border ink-200 bg-white icon buttons, lucide:chevrons-left and lucide:chevron-left DISABLED (ink-300, no hover), lucide:chevron-right and lucide:chevrons-right enabled (ink-700, hover:border-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-50 hover:text-emerald-700).

Below the table (mt-12), a three-up bordered strip = grid gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 on a bg-ink-200 ground (so the 1px gaps read as hairlines), sm:grid-cols-3. Each cell is a bg-white p-6 panel with a 36px rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 emerald-600 lucide icon tile, a 14px font-bold ink-900 title and a 14px leading-relaxed ink-500 line: 'Sortable, every column' (lucide:arrow-up-down) / 'Bulk selection' (lucide:check-check) / 'Honest pagination' (lucide:list-ordered).

A full-bleed footer with a hairline ink-200/70 top border on a faint ink-50/40 band, a max-w-7xl px-6/lg:px-8 row, py-8, flex-col -> sm:flex-row, items-center justify-between, gap-4, 14px ink-500. Left: a 24px rounded-md emerald-500 tile with a white lucide:table-2 + a font-semibold ink-700 'Tablecraft' wordmark. Center: 'Built from a single prompt · designed in the open'. Right: three ink-400 social icon links (lucide:github, lucide:twitter, lucide:book-open) that go emerald-600 on hover.

special_ui_components.prompt: A 16px custom checkbox replacing the native control: appearance none, width/height 16px, border-radius 5px, 1.5px solid #cbd5e1 (ink-300) border, white background, inline-grid place-content-center, transition all .12s. On :hover the border goes #10b981 (emerald). The :checked state fills #10b981 with an emerald border and renders a white tick via an ::after element masked from an inline SVG checkmark (9px). An '.indet' (indeterminate) state fills emerald and renders a 9px x 2px white horizontal dash instead of the tick, used on the select-all header to mean 'some but not all rows selected'.

A clickable table header rendered as a button group: the column label + a sort caret icon, transition-colors. INACTIVE columns are ink-500 with a muted ink-400 lucide:chevrons-up-down (up-down double caret) that brightens to ink-600 and whose label goes ink-900 on group hover. The ACTIVE-sort column is emerald-700 with a directional emerald-600 caret (lucide:arrow-down for descending / lucide:arrow-up for ascending), so the active sort is the only colored header in the row, the one place emerald marks state in the header.

The selected table row gets a soft emerald wash (bg-emerald-50/50, hover bg-emerald-50/80), its row checkbox is :checked (emerald fill + white tick), and its first cell carries a 3px inset emerald accent rule on the left edge via box-shadow inset 3px 0 0 0 #10b981, a precise 'this row is selected' affordance that doesn't add layout width.

A filter trigger styled as a dashed-outline button: h-9 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-ink-300 bg-white px-3, 14px font-medium ink-600, with a leading lucide icon (circle-dashed for Status, bar-chart-3 for Priority) and the filter name; on hover the dashed border and text turn emerald (hover:border-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-700). When values are selected it appends, behind a left ink-200 divider (border-l pl-2), small value chips: an emerald-50/emerald-700 '11px font-semibold' value chip ('In Progress') and an ink-100/ink-600 overflow chip ('+1'); the chip group hides below sm.

special_ui_components.component: Status / priority cell with state icon
special_ui_components.prompt: Each status and priority cell is an inline-flex of a small (13-14px) lucide state icon + a text label. Status uses semantic icons/colors: In Progress = emerald-500 loader-circle, Done = emerald-600 circle-check-big, Backlog = ink-400 circle-dashed, Canceled = ink-400 circle-x (with a muted ink-500 label). Priority uses neutral ink-400 directional icons: High = arrow-up, Medium = minus, Low = arrow-down, all with ink-700 labels. The icon carries the meaning and color; the label stays neutral, so scanning the column reads as a column of glyphs first.

The container for the whole table = rounded-2xl, overflow-hidden, 1px ink-200 border, white background, and a two-layer shadow shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(15,23,42,0.04),0_12px_40px_-12px_rgba(15,23,42,0.12)]: a tight 1px ambient shadow for the edge plus a soft, far, slightly-negative-spread drop shadow that lifts the card off the canvas without a hard halo. It vertically stacks toolbar / table / footer, each separated by an internal ink-200/80 hairline border.

A group of four 32px square rounded-lg buttons (border ink-200, bg-white) for first / previous / next / last (lucide:chevrons-left, chevron-left, chevron-right, chevrons-right). At page 1 the first/previous buttons are DISABLED (ink-300 icon, the disabled attribute, no hover), and the enabled next/last buttons go emerald on hover (hover:border-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-50 hover:text-emerald-700), an 'honest' control that visibly disables at the bounds rather than looking clickable.

The hero background texture: two 1px linear-gradients (to right and to bottom) in rgba(16,185,129,0.05) on a background-size 56px 56px tile, producing a barely-there emerald graph-paper grid, layered under a pointer-events-none soft emerald-300/20 blur-3xl radial glow near the top center, on a faint ink-50/40 band. It signals 'engineered / on a canvas' without competing with the table.

structured.special_notes: Built on the Tailwind CDN with a tailwind.config extend: fontFamily.sans = Inter (ui-sans-serif fallback); a full custom emerald scale (50 #ecfdf5, 100 #d1fae5, 200 #a7f3d0, 300 #6ee7b7, 400 #34d399, 500 #10b981, 600 #059669, 700 #047857, 800 #065f46, 900 #064e3b) and a cool slate 'ink' scale (50 #f8fafc, 100 #f1f5f9, 200 #e2e8f0, 300 #cbd5e1, 400 #94a3b8, 500 #64748b, 600 #475569, 700 #334155, 800 #1e293b, 900 #0f172a). Inter loads from Google Fonts (400;500;600;700;800); icons are Iconify lucide:* via the iconify CDN. Body sets font-feature-settings 'cv11','ss01', antialiased, optimizeLegibility, and a .tnum (tabular-nums) utility aligns IDs and counts. The signature move is the engineered shadcn-style tasks data table inside a soft-shadow rounded-2xl card: a tri-state select-all + per-row custom checkbox (.checkbox / .indet), sortable headers where only the active-sort column is emerald, semantic status/priority state-icon cells, a selected-row treatment (emerald wash + 3px inset emerald left rule), dashed faceted-filter buttons with value chips, one open row-actions dropdown, and an honest pagination footer whose edge buttons disable at the bounds. It is a single static demo frame: row hover tints, the focus ring, the checkbox state animation, the dashed-filter and pagination hover color shifts, and the (single) open dropdown only fully animate/toggle live, and the task rows, IDs, statuses and 'Tablecraft' brand are illustrative placeholders for a generic tasks/admin data table.
